desc: The region of uranium mines in Oklo, Gabon West Africa is examined in detail and shown that a natural nuclear reactor operated there 2 billion years ago. How this was possible is explained in terms of the different half-lives and the presence of an underground river. What this means for nuclear waste storage and its long-term effects.

recs.stt: Oklo has a plan to make tiny nuclear reactors that run off nuclear waste
